author: Russell Brand
description:
Can science still be trusted when the institutions that once demanded total obedience now quietly reverse themselves? As health agencies investigate vaccine-linked deaths and former insiders break ranks, a civil war inside the scientific establishment exposes how COVID turned science into a tool of power, profit, and political control. What’s unfolding isn’t anti-science backlash, but a reckoning with how consensus was enforced, dissent was punished, and truth was subordinated to authority—leaving public trust fractured and the credibility of modern science hanging in the balance.
